ruth_1-4_scripture-vision-board.html.description: A Scripture Vision Series board on the whole book of Ruth (KJV): the Moabitess who clave to Naomi, gleaned in the field of Boaz, came to trust under the wings of the LORD God of Israel, and was redeemed into the line of David.
